title: Halloween show: from bench to porch in two minutes
warning: Step 1 first: the swap happens with the board unpowered
credit: Board image: TI SLAU969 Figure 1-1; buttons and header from its Figure 4-2

label: Unplug the USB cable
Everything else is done with no power on the board.
Pull off whatever BoosterPack is on top
Lift it straight up from both header rows (J1/J3 left,
J4/J2 right).
Plug the BOOSTXL-AUDIO on the same rows
Its pin 1 goes to J1 pin 1 (3V3, top left).
On the pack, jumper J5 sits on SPI DAC (as shipped).
The show drives its pins 7, 12, 13, 15, 5 and 6.
Plug the power bank into the USB-C socket
The show starts by itself and loops forever.
If the bank turns off after a minute, it saw too
little current: use one with an always-on mode.
Buttons: S2 (right) short = next song,
long = next sound effect mode.
S1 (left) short = next light theme, long = volume.
Both together = shuffle on or off.
Do not hold S1 while plugging in (bootloader).

task_facts.head: The show
items: Grieg's Mountain King, Bach's Toccata opening, Saint-Saens' Danse macabre, an original tune; shuffled, with scare sounds between songs
The board's RGB LED: music, pumpkin, fire, lightning, ghost, heartbeat, witch; a candle glow between songs
Check J5 on the pack sits on SPI DAC; turn the volume up with a long S1 press
